en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Bakr Bin Salih, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A Prophet<sup>as</sup> from the Prophets<sup>as</sup> complained to Allah<sup>as</sup> Mighty and Majestic of the gloom, so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Commanded him<sup>as</sup> with eating the grapes’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Bakr ibn Salih in a marfu ‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One of the Prophets complained before Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, about sadness and Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, commanded him to eat grapes.’”
